title: Build an audio waveform-to-inference harness
hardware: CPU; target-edge validation is a separate extension

stages.title: Waveform and spectral contract
stages.evidence: Recording/split provenance, independent STFT, silence and tone-bin checks, actual WAV loading
stages.expected: PASS stage 1: waveform contracts, independent STFT, silence, frequency bins, actual WAV provenance and split isolation
stages.diagnosis: Check sample rate, channel axis, crop length, Hann convention and power normalization before changing the classifier.

stages.title: Training, recovery and held-out errors
stages.evidence: Analytic gradient, complete fresh-process recovery across an epoch boundary, fixed evaluation, baseline and changed conditions
stages.expected: PASS stage 2: gradient oracle, full fresh-process recovery, held-out aggregation, unchanged evaluation state and changed seed/data
stages.diagnosis: Compare recording IDs and crop/augmentation state before inspecting loss; keep fitted normalization tied to training data.

stages.title: Precision and complete exported artifacts
stages.evidence: Training-only calibration, integer arithmetic reference, six actual exports, fresh-process reload and failed-release rollback
stages.expected: PASS stage 3: training-only calibration, integer oracle, six complete exports, fresh-process reload and corruption rejection
stages.diagnosis: Inspect activation ranges, accumulator type and restored preprocessing; reject a mismatched or corrupt release.

stages.title: Measured inference and boundary drills
stages.evidence: Actual CPU timing samples, sample-rate/channel/version failures, silence and explicitly unmeasured edge costs
stages.expected: PASS stage 4: measured full preprocessing/inference boundary, malformed request drills and silence behavior
stages.diagnosis: Separate window accumulation, decoding, preprocessing, model execution and device measurements before claiming end-to-end latency.

rubric: Explain sample-rate, waveform, crop and STFT contracts with independent calculations
Preserve recording identities, groups, licenses and split provenance
Compare a trained spectral classifier with an energy baseline and inspect actual errors
Recover optimizer, normalization, RNG, crop and iterator state in a fresh process
Calibrate on training data and distinguish weight, feature, accumulation and output precision
Reload genuine exports containing spectral preprocessing and reject failed releases
Measure completed CPU requests while labeling unmeasured capture, network and device costs
Complete the bundled audio synthesis tasks with changed-condition evidence
setupNote: Run from the extracted ZIP top folder containing requirements-cpu.txt and projects/audio-harness. The README links executed plots, a connected reference runner and bundled synthesis/reviewer tasks. The fixture classifies synthetic sounds, not speech.
